points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for large-scale search systems.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring robust model quality for production.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and optimizing for high-throughput batch processing needs.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining security coverage.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for model evaluation and QA.
